Join DoSChem
Join DoSChem
There are several ways to join DoSChem, depending on your situation:
Looking for a PhD position? Apply via the DoSChem pooled call (once a year) or apply directly to an open PhD position - throughout the year.
New to the Faculty? Complete your DoSChem admission to join the doctoral school.
DoSChem Pooled Calls for prospective PhD Candidates
DoSChem launches an international spring call each year, offering doctoral training across all areas of chemistry. Applications are submitted centrally and forwarded to your preferred PIs. If selected, you will be contacted directly for interviews.
Information for External Applicants
Looking for Open Positions?
Open positions can be filled during the year, independently of the DoSChem call.
If available, an open position will be posted on the Faculty of Chemistry website.
Open positions
Already in a Research Group?
